title.en: Honmono no Seijo Janai to Bareta no ni, Outei Denka ni Semararete imasu
Denka, Anata ga Suteta Onna ga Honmono no Seijo desu
Watashi, Seijo. Ima, Kankinsarete Iru no
Inchiki Seijo to Iwareta no de, Kuni wo Dete Nonbiri Kurasou to Omoimasu
Outaishi Denka wa Koukyuu ni Uranaishi wo Goshomou desu
Senjou no Seijo ~Imouto no Kawari ni Koushaku Kishi ni Totsugu Koto ni narimashita ga, Ima wa Shiawase desu~
Gimai ga Seijo dakara to Konyakuhaki Saremashita ga, Watashi wa Yousei no Itoshigo desu
Yomei Wazuka Dakara to Tsuihou Sareta Seijo desu ga, Junrei no Tabi ni Detara Chou Kenkou ni Narimashita
Kon'yakusha ga Uwaki Aite to Kakeochi shimashita. Ouji Denka ni Dekiaisarete Shiawase na no de, Imasara Modoritai to Iwarete mo Komarimasu.
Veil no Seijo - Minikui to Gokaisareta Seijo, Ikemen Goei Kishi ni Dekiaisareru
Konyaku Haki Shita Aite ga Mainichi Shazai ni Kimasu ga, Fukuen Nante Zettai ni Ariemasen!

title.ja-ro: Kanpeki Sugite Kawaige ga Nai to Kon'yaku Haki Sareta Seijo wa Ringoku ni Urareru

title.en: Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu
Ochibure Saijo no Koufuku Heika ni Suterareta no de, Saiai no Hito wo Sukui ni ikimasu
Watashi wa Teki ni narimasen! - Aku no Majutsushi ni Tensei shitakedo, Shinu no wa Gomen na no de Scenario ni Sakaratte Ikinobimasu
